verdict.rationale: ADK docs describe a test-file based approach for single agent-model interaction sessions described explicitly as 'a form of unit testing' (google-adk-docs-8, google-adk-docs-21), plus eval sets with expected tool-use trajectories (google-adk-docs-25, google-adk-docs-30) and CLI eval runner (google-adk-gh-13, google-adk-gh-18). However, evidence doesn't explicitly describe mocking models or tools as a mechanism—evaluation appears to run against real/configured models rather than documented mock/stub injection. missing for 10: explicit documentation of mocking/stubbing models or tools APIs, examples of dependency-injection or fake model classes for isolated unit tests, independent corroboration of unit-test workflows.
